Debtbuster - a nightmare you cant get out of

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
Debtbusters: When your debts all become too overwhelming you turn to the professionals to help you out and keep the creditors off your back. Initially the administration process goes quite smoothly but when you have a problem and things have gone horribly wrong it can take months to resolve, if they ever do. People get passed from one consultant to the next and no one seems to remember what they told the last one. If they want to terminate their services, you aren’t released until you can prove all your accounts have been paid up and will still need to pay. Now they can’t even walk into their officers to speak to someone because of Covid 19. Their Debt crisis has just got bigger. This story was repeated in various forms by many people who have complained on Hello Peter and written into us

Summary:
Debt Busters promise that will can negotiate lower interest rates with the banks and your creditors and will handle your debt crisis. Some of the creditors are not being paid at all. The amounts they are paying off of their debt are extremely low so they get stuck in this cycle for far longer than if they had just paid it off themselves. Some people have ended up paying off the debt themselves yet Debtbusters haven’t removed them from their register and so they cannot get finance because their credit record is damaged. Some case studies have found Debtbusters have blatantly lied to them saying they have paid off creditors when in fact they haven’t and have paid them off themselves.. One case study discovered that the interest rate they had negotiated on her behalf saw her paying nearly R80 000 more than she needed to and only when she enquired did she discover this. She had to negotiate with Standard bank and they are paying back R25 000. Another case study lost her job at the beginning of lockdown and informed Debtbusters that she could not pay her monthly instalments and they needed to inform her creditors, they failed to submit her forms and now when any money does get deposited into her account they remove it immediately. She is a widow who supports 5 children and that money is her lifeline.
So you think you sign up and pay monthly and Debtbusters are handling your problems but it turns out they not- it’s still up to you to follow up on all the debts and for many this is just not what they signed up for. Have Debtbusters just got too big and greedy to rectify these errors and what’s the impact on peoples lives? With the Debt crisis spiralling out of control are consumers getting ripped off?

Script:


Link: The impact of lockdown is really hitting people hard, I mean its rough on every level personal loans are almost double that of last year, and people are generally struggling to pay off their debts
Script: And South Africans are already over indebted
Link: When you're drowning in debt one of the options is to go into debt review, which promises to keep your creditors at bay and handle the payment process, all you have to do is ensure you pay the fixed monthly instalment, but it just not that straight forward
Script: If you have an income, you can hand yourself over to a debt counselling company, who will asses your debt, and renegotiate your payments terms with your creditors to what you can afford. A good debt review company can negotiate significantly lower interest rates. They say, it will take 5 years to sort you out
Alicia “ I just felt like I will just pay them every month and I will forget about it and 5 years will fly by and it will be over and it just hasn’t been like that
Script: Alicia Mans is a freelance graphic designer, who hit a bad patch in 2017 and was without work for a while.
Alicia “I took it upon myself to be honest and to say I would still like to pay it but I can’t pay as much
Script: She went to Debtbusters, an award winning debt counselling company, who managed to drop her monthly payments by about R6000. Debtbusters handles the negotiations and the administration and deals with your creditors but the payments have to be done through a payment distribution agency, appointed by the National Credit Regulator, in this,case Hyphen PDA
Alicia “It's been a problem since day one. I constantly have to follow up with them when I started checking my statements and there was problems with the overdraft amounts on this or the hyphen PDA statements weren’t correlating with what was going on my online banking profile.
Script: After paying diligently for nearly 3 years, she got shock of her life, when her bank phoned to say none of her bank loans were being paid
Alicia “If I don’t start paying it they going to hand me over. I then asked them which accounts and then they said all of them. So I started investigating immediately phoned Debtbusters to ask them what was going on and I didn't get a response. I started doing my own investigation and then I find out that that account was actually never paid I have interest been built up for 3 years and 4 months
Script: Alicia discovered that R27 000 of her payments had gone into somebody else’s bank account, instead of paying off her debt, in effect she had been paying off somebody else debt. Debtbusters told her to be patient, first the owner of the bank account, needed to agree to give the money back, that was 7 months ago

Alicia”So it's just consumed a lot of my time to try and get to the bottom of this. I'm losing hours in my work if I don't work. I don't get paid. My last resort was Carte Blanche because I don’t know how else I would have sorted this out

Script: One thing Debt review is supposed to do is protect you from being handed over and being pursued by debt collectors, but this wasn’t the case for Morag de Beer
Morag: I lost my job and we ended up with more debt than anything else I mean our entire salary was literally going towards debt

Script: Debtbusters renegotiated her payments down by R20 000 a month. But the harassing calls still didn’t stop
Morag: For some reason Mr. Price Mobile was handing me over to collection agencies and they were saying that there was non payment to the account but I was paying Debtbusters the agreed upon amount every month

Script: She ask Debtbusters to sort it out

Morag “ When I first complained that I was receiving these harassing phone calls they should have been investigated that and they didn't. So it stretched on for over two and a half years
Script: Having lost confidence in Debtbusters, Morag started to go through the rest of her debts with a fine tooth comb, to her horror, on one account she discovered nearly R36 000 more in interest than agreed

Morag: I was shocked to discover that the interest is more than the amount that's being paid every month because the interest was never sorted So instead of lessing my debt I actually am sitting now with more debt than when I started

Script: Senior attorney of the University of Stellenbosch law clinic Stephan van der Merwe says people must be fully aware of all the pro and cons before going under debt review, because once you start you cannot get out until all your debts are paid up, even your bond

Stephan: We find that most of the complaints we get are from people who were not properly informed or maybe didn't properly understand these legal implications of going under debt review, for example. They're not able to access credit from the moment that they apply to be placed on a debt review. ..this means you're not able to use your credit card, garage card, store credit you're not able to access overdrafts. And then there is also the matter of the debt counsellor and the payment distribution agencies who is normally responsible for distributing payments they need to be paid so they have fees so going into debt review so going under debt counselling can be quite a costly experience as well

Morag: I have two boys at home my youngest is in grade 9 and my eldest is finishing school and he wants to go and study engineering and I couldn't get a loan for him to go if I wanted to, it’s impossible

Script: Lesego Baloyi bought her car 3 years ago with finance for R125 400, but when she lost her job, she struggled to keep up with the payments. When she went into debt review, Debtbusters renegotiated the payments terms but Lesego says- she would never have agreed to them if they had told her the full cost implications

Lesego “I cried and especially at the realization that, the same car that I have driven for 3 years ..it’s like I have never even paid a single cent,
Script: Debtbusters got Lesego’s monthly car repayments down by just under R1000 but that extended the repayment by another 4 years. This meant- her interest increased by R49 000 and she would end up paying R184 000 for her car
Lesgo “But I wasn't told about that Debtbusters they should have told you need to make them aware of what they are getting themselves into so when you send them balances on their statements you need to give them the accurate balances as per what the bank gives them but no they don't do that
Script: We received numerous complaints about Debtbuster and picked up many more on Hello Peter. COO Benay Sayer, agreed to investigate them. He said the bank gave them the wrong account number for Alicia and that's why her R27 000 was paid into the wrong bank account

Benay: I can understand that it's been very frustrating for the consumer so therefore out of our goodwill Debt buster paid the amount that was outstanding for the consumer.

Masa: Will debt busters reverse the accumulating interest rates that have been adding up since 2017

Benay: as far as we know there is no additional interest ….we will work with the consumer to make sure that she doesn't pay more than she has to

Script: Then there Morag’s 14 missing payments to the Mobile company, and endless harassment from debt collectors
Masa: Isn't that your job to be a buffer between her and your creditor

Benay: so the creditor in question sold the account to an attorney firm which are debt collectors which is out of our control We don't manage those accounts in terms of what happens and when those when the account was sold to the attorney firm they started calling the consumer and saying you owe us a balance

Morag “Why does it take 4 months of fighting, for them to realise ok there is a problem ok let's pay it off, when I have been trying to sort this problem for the last 2 and half years

Script: And the interest on her loan account accumulating nearly R36 000 more than agreed to

Benay We have good relationships with this lender and I feel very comfortable and confident that we will make sure that this the balance will get back to what it needs to be to make sure again that the consumer isn't prejudiced against
Masa: But isn't that your sale that once I come to Debtbusters I can rest assured that you will handle these matters for me. I don't need to do the digging

Benay “Well I think it's important for consumers to also go through their monthly statements. we do proactively go through many accounts but as I said before we make sure that every single consumer's account before they finish debt counselling is settled in such a way that the consumer didn't have to pay more than what they had to
Masa: These are the big mistakes that are happening to not just numbers it’s people's lives
Benay: So this is a longstanding industry issue. And what happens is that debt counsellors don't have access to credit provider systems, but there have been efforts to develop a centralized system where everyone can have access to the balances in real time and see the same balances. So I understand the uneasiness that consumers go through when they see the mismatch of balances and we try to rectify them as soon as they are identified
Masa: going to Lesego’s case forty nine thousand rand more than she would have actually had to pay for her debt. What happened there

Benay “She was always going to need to pay that amount in the long term but because the amount was lowered on a monthly basis it extended over a period of time. All of that became payable during the part of Debt review. That's why it was the first time she was exposed to the fact that there was a bigger payment in terms of owning the vehicle.

Masa: These sound like simple explanations. One of the concerns we had you get a new consultant every single time you query something don't you think of what you're saying to me was just basically said to them and there was some cohesion we wouldn't be here right now.

Benay: We can always do better in terms of explanations. I would also like to point out is that our consumers save about a billion rand per year in terms of foregone interest rates payments and fees they no longer have to pay.

Script: Debtbusters has saved consumers huge amounts of interest- but you have to keep your eye on the detail

Alicia” I would say rather try and make a plan speaking to your banks or creditors yourself and trying to make payment arrangements because this is really ….it has been so stressful I feel physically ill because of it
Promo 15 01 16 16 last sound bite Alicia “it has been so stressful I feel physically ill because of it” Debt review is supposed to take the headache out of resolving your debt problems but for these consumers it’s a nightmare
Promo15 '' Personal loans are up by 50% on last year and debt is spiralling out of control. Handing yourself over for debt review seems like a lifesaver but it's just not that simple
Promo 15” The sleepless nights of wondering if you can make your debt repayments should go away when you go under debt review but then keeping track of what's actually happening, turns into a nightmare

metadata.Summary: Debt Busters promise that will can negotiate lower interest rates with the banks and your creditors and will handle your debt crisis. Some of the creditors are not being paid at all. The amounts they are paying off of their debt are extremely low so they get stuck in this cycle for far longer than if they had just paid it off themselves. Some people have ended up paying off the debt themselves yet Debtbusters haven’t removed them from their register and so they cannot get finance because their credit record is damaged. Some case studies have found Debtbusters have blatantly lied to them saying they have paid off creditors when in fact they haven’t and have paid them off themselves.. One case study discovered that the interest rate they had negotiated on her behalf saw her paying nearly R80 000 more than she needed to and only when she enquired did she discover this. She had to negotiate with Standard bank and they are paying back R25 000. Another case study lost her job at the beginning of lockdown and informed Debtbusters that she could not pay her monthly instalments and they needed to inform her creditors, they failed to submit her forms and now when any money does get deposited into her account they remove it immediately. She is a widow who supports 5 children and that money is her lifeline. So you think you sign up and pay monthly and Debtbusters are handling your problems but it turns out they not- it’s still up to you to follow up on all the debts and for many this is just not what they signed up for. Have Debtbusters just got too big and greedy to rectify these errors and what’s the impact on peoples lives? With the Debt crisis spiralling out of control are consumers getting ripped off?
